name: v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha1
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha1

- kiosk: adapt the interface to ultrawide and bar screens (canvas up to 6:1, 440-point canvas for bar panels, wide Now Playing, home, albums, CD changer, settings); original VU panel kept
- kiosk (ultrawide test): fullscreen VU plate grows in width in 7 slices, meters grouped, title in a header
- WIP ultrawide: fullscreen VU = long plate (stretched middle), track info on the plate
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing clock next to the left buttons
- WIP ultrawide: CD changer big on the right in wide canvases; test-only ui-test-bar
- WIP ultrawide: bar player text centred, play button under the title
- WIP ultrawide: bar player controls centred, volume on its own row
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing = player | VU | album
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing = cover | VU | title and controls
- WIP ultrawide: 440-point canvas for bar panels (home, panel, albums, Now Playing)
- WIP ultrawide: Now Playing stacked right column (header, big VU, bottom controls)
- WIP ultrawide test: ui-test-aspect override
- WIP ultrawide test: canvas up to 6:1, wide/ultra levels, 3-column Now Playing, home/album columns
- ci: a dev's changelog starts from the previous dev, not from its last alpha
- vu store: Blue Neon v2, the meter sits higher in Now Playing
- vu store: Blue Neon, a backlit neon meter
- ci: CodeQL once a night instead of on every push
- ci: keep the A/B image artifact one day, not fourteen
- website: the F-Droid index is not a download, only the APKs are counted
- website: the same client fetching the same file within an hour counts once
- companion: 1.0.14
- companion: three crashes from the Play console fixed
- ci: releases start the Cloudflare Pages deploy themselves
- website: in line with main
